propositions: Multiple network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeout parameters and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
subprocess.TimeoutExpired exceptions from unbounded git calls can escape error handling and leak credential information (user:token@host URLs) in exception messages
gerrit_client.py and workspace.py require module-level _GIT_TIMEOUT = 300 constant and timeout-aware subprocess calls matching the precedent established in 747f (repo_snapshot.py)
timeout exceptions from git calls must be caught and converted to module-specific error types (GerritError, WorkspaceError) with sanitized messages naming the operation and bound
ref_lock.py's _git helper is already structurally bounded via required keyword-only timeout parameter and requires no changes
Two deferred call sites in _commands/init.py and _commands/fsck_repair.py are blocked by concurrent work (task 01e8-302b-ab8f-4220) and split to separate ticket 983f-ee85-1e06-428e
